description: This file defines the interface IGuide within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It provides methods for accessing and managing guide-related data, such as channels, programs, parental controls, and notifications related to electronic program guide (EPG) features.

classes.name: IGuide
classes.description: An interface for accessing guide information and controlling guide features in the system.

classes.name: IGuide::INotification
classes.description: An interface for receiving guide-related notifications such as EIT broadcasts, alerts, parental control changes, and test notifications.

methods.name: StartParser
methods.description: Starts the guide parser with a given shell context.

methods.name: GetChannels
methods.description: Retrieves a string representing available channels.

methods.name: GetPrograms
methods.description: Retrieves a string representing current programs.

methods.name: GetCurrentProgram
methods.description: Gets information about the current program for a given channel.

methods.name: GetAudioLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves available audio languages for a given program or channel.

methods.name: GetSubtitleLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves available subtitle languages for a given program or channel.

methods.name: SetParentalControlPin
methods.description: Sets the PIN for parental control.

methods.name: SetParentalControl
methods.description: Enables or disables parental control for specified content.

methods.name: IsParentalControlled
methods.description: Checks if parental control is enabled.

methods.name: SetParentalLock
methods.description: Locks or unlocks parental access for specific content.

methods.name: IsParentalLocked
methods.description: Checks if specific content is parental locked.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for guide events.

ctags.name: IGuide
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL IGuide : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
